verdict.rationale: Postman exposes a documented, versioned public API (postman-docs-5), a functioning OpenAPI spec confirmed via live probe (postman-probe-3), a working CLI for headless/agentic use (postman-probe-6), and an official MCP server for AI-agent interaction (postman-probe-4, postman-probe-7), all backed by extensive docs on CLI/API/CI-CD integration (postman-docs-1,3,6,19).
